items.problem: OpenCvSharp4 build errors while re-implementing OpenCVHelper.cs: CS0619 obsolete Mat(int,int,MatType,nint,long) ctor (use Mat.FromPixelData), CS1061 MatExpr has no Rows/Cols (materialize to Mat), CS1519 stray brace.
items.evidence: build-events.jsonl: 16x CS0619 on Mat ctor, 20x CS1061 on MatExpr.Rows/Cols, 4x CS1519 — all in OpenCVHelper.cs; agent fixed them and the final build succeeded.
items.covered_clearly_at: N/A — out of scope for the migration skill. These are OpenCvSharp4 library-version/API details, not UWP->WinUI 3 migration patterns. The migration skill correctly does not (and should not) enumerate third-party CV library APIs.
items.why_no_skill_change: These are third-party NuGet library specifics unrelated to the UWP->WinUI migration surface. A capable model re-implementing against OpenCvSharp4 will resolve obsolete-ctor/API-shape errors from the compiler messages themselves; encoding one CV library's API churn into the migration skill would not generalize and would bloat it.
